name: go_router_builder
summary: The official code generator for go_router strongly-typed route helpers. It converts route definitions into generated navigation helpers so required parameters and parameter types can be checked statically.
advantages: Generates strongly-typed route helpers for go_router
Moves missing or incorrectly typed route-parameter errors toward static analysis and compile time
Reduces hand-written go, push, and location boilerplate
Can detect duplicate route paths during generation
tradeoffs: Requires generated .g.dart files and a build system such as build_runner
Adds value primarily when the project already uses go_router
recommendedFor: go_router projects that want type-safe route parameters
Projects that want to avoid hand-written route strings and navigation boilerplate
Projects already using Dart code generation

verification.reason: Current pub.dev documentation explicitly documents the strongly-typed routing goal, generated helpers, and build requirements.
